package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in this report. The text discusses secure software supply chain practices and Sonatype's platform capabilities for defending against supply chain attacks, but does not analyze or present any actual malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Quarantining suspicious components at download time
Continuous monitoring of component vulnerabilities and license status
Automated notification to stakeholders upon detection of new vulnerabilities
Blocking or flagging components with critical CVEs during CI/CD pipeline
file_indicators: SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) files generated and monitored
Policy violation logs in CI/CD systems
network_indicators: Repository proxy traffic for component downloads
Automated notifications sent to stakeholders (email, dashboard alerts)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor repository proxy logs for components flagged as suspicious or quarantined. Track SBOM generation and updates for all components in use. Set up alerting for policy violations in CI/CD pipelines, especially those triggered by new CVEs or license issues. Review notification logs to ensure stakeholders are informed of critical security events.
